+#!/bin/bash
+# Checks the cloud-routine port: start_review.sh calls the routine and maps
+# its status, and no workflow still runs on the desktop runner.
+# Run: bash scripts/tests/test_cloud_port.sh
+set -uo pipefail
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+failures=0
+
+fail() { echo "FAIL: $*"; failures=$((failures + 1)); }
+pass() { echo "ok: $*"; }
+
+# Runs start_review.sh against a mock routine that answers with $1.
+# Sets $exit_code and leaves the captured request in $work/capture.
+run_against() {
+  : > "$work/port"
+  : > "$work/capture"
+  python3 "$root/scripts/tests/mock_routine.py" "$work/port" "$1" "$work/capture" &
+  local mock=$!
+  for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$work/port")/run" \
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=test-token \
+  REVIEW_MODEL=test-model REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+    bash "$root/scripts/start_review.sh" 42 > "$work/out" 2>&1
+  exit_code=$?
+  kill "$mock" 2>/dev/null
+  wait "$mock" 2>/dev/null
+}
+
+run_against 200
+if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then pass "200 exits 0"; else fail "200 exited $exit_code: $(cat "$work/out")"; fi
+grep -q '^Authorization: Bearer test-token$' "$work/capture" \
+  && pass "sends bearer token" || fail "bearer token missing"
+body=$(tail -n +3 "$work/capture")
+if [ "$(jq -c . <<<"$body" 2>/dev/null)" = '{"pull_request":42,"model":"test-model","effort":"high"}' ]; then
+  pass "sends pull_request, model, effort"
+else
+  fail "unexpected body: $body"
+fi
+
+run_against 422
+if [ "$exit_code" -eq 1 ] && [ -s "$work/capture" ]; then pass "422 exits 1"; else fail "422 (blocking findings) exited $exit_code"; fi
+
+run_against 500
+if [ "$exit_code" -eq 2 ] && [ -s "$work/capture" ]; then pass "500 exits 2"; else fail "500 (routine failed) exited $exit_code"; fi
+
+# Nothing listens on port 9 on loopback, so the connection is refused.
+CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:9/run" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t REVIEW_MODEL=m REVIEW_EFFORT=e \
+  bash "$root/scripts/start_review.sh" 42 > "$work/out" 2>&1
+exit_code=$?
+if [ "$exit_code" -eq 2 ]; then pass "unreachable routine exits 2"; else fail "unreachable routine exited $exit_code"; fi
+
+for wf in pr-review rerun-review; do
+  file="$root/.github/workflows/$wf.yml"
+  if grep -q 'desktop' "$file"; then fail "$wf still targets the desktop runner"; else pass "$wf off desktop"; fi
+  grep -q 'runs-on: \[self-hosted, nas\]' "$file" && pass "$wf runs on nas" || fail "$wf does not run on nas"
+  grep -q 'CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN: \${{ secrets.CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN }}' "$file" \
+    && pass "$wf passes routine token" || fail "$wf does not pass routine token"
+done
+
+echo "$failures failure(s)"
+[ "$failures" -eq 0 ]

I read all seven files in the repository and changed nothing. A separate verifier agent checked each claim below against its source and confirmed them all. Item 5 has one caveat, noted there.

## Risks, most severe first

**1. Merges could stop for every pull request.**
- Branch protection requires the `ai-review` check to pass before a merge (`notes/findings.md:7`).
- The cloud session's proxy refuses writes to the GitHub check-runs API (`notes/findings.md:5`). So the cloud routine cannot open or complete the check itself.
- If no other job writes the check, it never passes, or it stays `in_progress` forever. Either way, merges are blocked.
- The NAS runner can do short jobs and HTTP calls (`README.md:23`). It is the likely place to keep the check-run steps and send the POST to the routine.

**2. The App private key would be used from a new machine.**
- The key has only ever been used from the desktop runner (`notes/findings.md:6`).
- If the NAS opens the check, it has to mint the App token, so `REVIEW_APP_KEY` gets used there for the first time. That is untested, and it adds one more machine that can use the key.

**3. Reviews running at the same time can sign each other out.**
- The cloud session holds one reviewer sign-in, set up once (`docs/cloud-routine.md:8`).
- That sign-in refreshes about every 10 days. Two sessions that refresh at the same moment can sign one of them out (`notes/findings.md:4`).
- Yesterday's trial only shows that two reviews started together both exited 0 (`notes/findings.md:3`). It does not show a refresh during the overlap.
- Neither workflow has a `concurrency:` group, so new PRs, pushes and `/rereview` comments can overlap.
- After a sign-out, every review fails until someone sets the sign-in up again. Because of risk 1, merges stop for that whole time.

**4. Timeouts.**
- The POST waits up to 30 minutes for the review to finish (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`). A review that runs longer counts as a failure.
- Neither workflow sets `timeout-minutes`, and nothing in the repository says how long the NAS or its proxy keeps an HTTP connection open.

**5. A broken routine and a bad review can look the same.**
- The routine returns `200` for a pass, `422` for blocking findings, and any other status for its own failure (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`).
- Today the check takes its result from `${{ job.status }}` (`pr-review.yml:27`, `rerun-review.yml:28`). If that stays, a failed routine and blocking findings both show as `failure`.
- Caveat: the same is true today only if the reviewer exits non-zero on blocking findings. The repository does not say whether it does.

**6. It is not documented how the routine posts its comments.**
- The routine posts its review comments itself, and the request body carries no GitHub token (`docs/cloud-routine.md:6`).
- The repository does not say which GitHub identity the routine uses. It also does not say whether the proxy allows comment writes. The findings only cover check-runs.

**7. New credential, and cost moves to the cloud.**
- Anyone who has `CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN` can start reviews (`docs/cloud-routine.md:5`).
- `rerun-review.yml:8` does not check who wrote the comment, so any commenter can start a review with `/rereview`. Each one becomes a paid cloud run.

**8. Existing check-run bugs the move would carry over.**
- `complete` and `complete-for-pr` create a second check run with a new POST. They do not update the one that `open` created (`scripts/check_run.sh:11-12`).
- In `rerun-review.yml`, the open step and the complete step each look up the head SHA again (`check_run.sh:10,12`). A push between them puts the two check runs on different commits, and the first one stays `in_progress`.
- A 30-minute review makes that gap wider.

**9. Rollout.** While both paths are live, one PR could get two reviews and two sets of comments.

## Open questions
- Does the reviewer exit non-zero on blocking findings?
- Which GitHub identity does the routine use to post comments?
- How long does the NAS keep an HTTP connection open?

The repository does not answer these. Settling them would need a test run against the routine or the NAS, which I did not do.

When you want changes made, the core work is: keep the check-run steps on the NAS, turn the routine's HTTP status into the check result, add a `concurrency:` group and `timeout-minutes`, and fix the duplicate check runs. A lock-and-refresh system for the shared sign-in would be new scope, so I would ask before building one.

**6. The check can pass on a commit that was not reviewed.** The POST body sends only the pull request number, model, and effort (`docs/cloud-routine.md:6`). The routine reviews whatever the head commit is when it runs. The workflow writes the check against a commit it chose itself. In `rerun-review.yml`, the commit is looked up again when the check closes (`scripts/check_run.sh:10,12`). If someone pushes during a 30-minute review, a pass can land on the new, unreviewed commit. This bug exists today, but longer reviews make it more likely.

**7. The comments may come from a different account.** Today the reviewer posts comments with whatever login the desktop has, because `start_review.sh` gets no token (partly inferred). The routine "posts the review comments itself" with an identity the docs do not name. No trial tested whether the proxy allows those comment writes.

**8. The status codes still need mapping, and every failure looks the same.** No workflow uses `CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL` or `CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN` yet. A new step must turn 200, 422, and other codes into a check result. A broken routine and a review with blocking findings both block the merge, and the check does not say which one happened.

**9. More runs now cost money.** Anyone who can comment can trigger `/rereview`. The workflow does not check who the commenter is, and `startsWith` also matches text like `/rereviewxyz` (`rerun-review.yml:8`). Each trigger becomes a paid cloud run that uses the shared sign-in. Retrying after a timeout could also post the same comments twice.

## Existing bugs that the move makes more visible

- **Each review leaves an open check behind.** `check_run.sh` closes a check by creating a second check run (`scripts/check_run.sh:11-12`). The first one stays `in_progress`.
- **Some pull requests never get a result.** If minting the token fails, for example on a pull request from a fork, the closing step has no token. The required check never reports.
- **Some events skip the review.** `pr-review.yml` runs only on `opened` and `synchronize`. A reopened pull request, or a draft marked ready, needs a manual `/rereview`.

## To check before deciding

- Branch protection details, and whether the App limits IP addresses. Both need access to GitHub.
- A trial that forces a sign-in refresh while two reviews run.
- Whether the routine can post comments through the proxy, and under which account.
- How to seed the sign-in again after a sign-out.

When you want to go ahead, I can plan the changes: run the check step on the NAS with a timeout and a concurrency group, then map the status codes.

+# Runs the review on the cloud routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for it.
+# Exits 0 when the review passed and 1 otherwise, so the job status is the check result.

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/start_review.sh against a local stub of the cloud routine,
+# and checks that both workflows run on the NAS and call the routine.
+set -uo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+failures=0
+
+cleanup() {
+  [ -n "${stub_pid:-}" ] && kill "$stub_pid" 2>/dev/null
+  find "$work" -mindepth 1 -delete
+  rmdir "$work"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+fail() { echo "FAIL: $*"; failures=$((failures + 1)); }
+pass() { echo "ok:   $*"; }
+
+# The stub answers each POST with the code in $work/code and saves the request.
+cat > "$work/stub.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        with open(f"{work}/request.json", "w") as f:
+            json.dump({"auth": self.headers.get("Authorization"), "body": body.decode()}, f)
+        code = int(open(f"{work}/code").read())
+        self.send_response(code)
+        self.end_headers()
+    def log_message(self, *a):
+        pass
+s = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+open(f"{work}/port", "w").write(str(s.server_address[1]))
+s.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 -I "$work/stub.py" "$work" &
+stub_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+url="http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$work/port")/review"
+
+run_start() {
+  : > "$work/request.json"
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=${URL_OVERRIDE:-$url} CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=secret-token \
+    REVIEW_MODEL=${MODEL:-claude-opus-5-5} REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+    timeout 20 bash "$repo/scripts/start_review.sh" "${PR:-42}" > "$work/out" 2>&1
+}
+
+echo 200 > "$work/code"
+if run_start; then pass "200 exits 0"; else fail "200 should exit 0: $(cat "$work/out")"; fi
+if [ -s "$work/request.json" ] && jq -e '
+    .auth == "Bearer secret-token"
+    and (.body | fromjson) == {"pull_request": 42, "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "effort": "high"}' \
+    "$work/request.json" > /dev/null; then
+  pass "request carries bearer token and JSON body"
+else
+  fail "request wrong: $(cat "$work/request.json" 2>/dev/null)"
+fi
+
+echo 422 > "$work/code"
+if run_start; then fail "422 should exit non-zero"; else pass "422 exits non-zero"; fi
+grep -qi "blocking" "$work/out" && pass "422 names blocking findings" || fail "422 message: $(cat "$work/out")"
+
+echo 500 > "$work/code"
+if run_start; then fail "500 should exit non-zero"; else pass "500 exits non-zero"; fi
+
+if URL_OVERRIDE="http://127.0.0.1:1/review" run_start; then
+  fail "connection failure should exit non-zero"
+else
+  pass "connection failure exits non-zero"
+fi
+
+if PR="42; rm" run_start; then fail "non-numeric PR should be rejected"; else pass "non-numeric PR rejected"; fi
+if MODEL='bad"model' run_start; then fail "quote in model should be rejected"; else pass "quote in model rejected"; fi
+echo 200 > "$work/code"
+if MODEL='claude-opus-5-5[1m]' run_start; then pass "model with brackets accepted"; else fail "brackets rejected: $(cat "$work/out")"; fi
+
+for wf in pr-review rerun-review; do
+  f="$repo/.github/workflows/$wf.yml"
+  grep -q "desktop" "$f" && fail "$wf still uses the desktop runner" || pass "$wf off desktop"
+  grep -q "runs-on: \[self-hosted, nas\]" "$f" && pass "$wf runs on nas" || fail "$wf not on nas"
+  grep -q 'CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL: ${{ vars.CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL }}' "$f" && pass "$wf passes routine URL" || fail "$wf missing routine URL"
+  grep -q 'CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN }}' "$f" && pass "$wf passes routine token" || fail "$wf missing routine token"
+  grep -q "timeout-minutes:" "$f" && pass "$wf has a timeout" || fail "$wf has no timeout"
+done
+
+echo "failures: $failures"
+[ "$failures" -eq 0 ]

meta.prior_reply:
I read every file in the repository and edited nothing. A separate verifier agent checked each risk below against the files and confirmed all 12. It did not check live GitHub settings, because the repository has no remote. Five of the risks come only from yesterday's trial notes in `notes/findings.md`.

## Risks that block merges

1. **The cloud routine cannot write the `ai-review` check.** The cloud proxy refuses writes to the check-runs API (`notes/findings.md:5`). The routine only posts review comments (`docs/cloud-routine.md:6`). So a GitHub runner must still open and complete the check.
2. **Every merge needs that check.** Branch protection requires `ai-review` to pass (`notes/findings.md:7`). If the check is missing or never completes, no pull request can merge.
3. **Blocking findings could be marked as a pass.** The routine returns `422` when it finds blocking issues, and only `200` means pass (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`). A plain `curl` still exits 0 on a 422; the verifier tested this. Both workflows set the check result from `job.status` (`pr-review.yml:27`, `rerun-review.yml:28`). So a simple `curl` step would mark a failed review as `success`.
4. **No timeouts are set.** Neither workflow sets `timeout-minutes`, and the POST can wait up to 30 minutes (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`). If the call hangs, it holds the runner and the check stays in progress, which blocks merges.
5. **The check gets stuck if the token step fails.** The complete step runs with `if: always()`, but it needs the App token (`pr-review.yml:28-29`). If minting the token fails, the check is never completed.

## Credentials and sign-in

6. **The App key has never been used anywhere but the desktop.** The review App's private key has only been used from the desktop runner (`notes/findings.md:6`). Minting the token on the NAS or a hosted runner is untested.
7. **The shared reviewer sign-in can expire or be lost.** It must refresh about every 10 days. Two sessions that refresh at the same moment can sign one of them out (`notes/findings.md:4`). The cloud sign-in was "seeded at setup" (`docs/cloud-routine.md:8`), and no file says who refreshes it.
8. **The concurrency test proves little.** One trial showed two reviews at once both exiting 0 (`notes/findings.md:3`). It does not show that the comments were correct or posted at all.
9. **Comment posting from the cloud is unproven.** No file says which GitHub credential the routine uses to post comments. The proxy already blocks check-run writes, and no trial note shows a comment that was posted.

## Concurrency and runner capacity

10. **Reviews can overlap.** Neither workflow has a `concurrency:` group. Several quick pushes could start overlapping cloud reviews on the one shared sign-in. They could also post duplicate comments. No cancel endpoint is documented.
11. **The NAS runner may become a queue.** The README says the NAS runner is for "Short jobs and HTTP calls" (`README.md:23`). Each review would hold it for up to 30 minutes, so other pull requests would wait behind it.
12. **A rerun can put its result on the wrong commit.** `complete-for-pr` looks up the head SHA again when the review ends (`scripts/check_run.sh:12`). If someone pushes during the review, the result lands on the new commit. A longer cloud review makes this more likely.

## Cost and abuse

13. **Anyone who can comment can start a paid cloud run.** `rerun-review.yml:8` checks only that the comment starts with `/rereview`, not who wrote it. A comment like `/rereviewxyz` also matches. Each one starts a run of up to 30 minutes.

## Smaller gaps

14. **Empty settings could pass through silently.** `start_review.sh:5-6` stops the job if `REVIEW_MODEL` or `REVIEW_EFFORT` is empty. The POST body needs the same check.
15. **The `pull_request` format is not defined.** `docs/cloud-routine.md:6` does not say whether the field is a number or a URL.
16. **These problems exist today and carry over:**
    - `check_run.sh` creates a new check run to complete the review instead of updating the open one, so an in-progress run is left behind every time (`scripts/check_run.sh:11`).
    - Pull requests from forks get no secrets, so they never get the check.
    - `reopened` and `ready_for_review` events do not start a review (`pr-review.yml:4`).

Risks 1–5 decide whether the move is safe. The workflow must keep writing the check from a GitHub runner, set the result from the HTTP status, and use a timeout.

I made no file changes. A separate verifier agent checked each repository claim below against the files and confirmed it. Two points about GitHub behaviour are not verified, because the proxy blocked docs.github.com this session. I mark those points.

## Risks of moving the reviews to the cloud routine

**1. The merge gate can break.**
- The cloud proxy refuses writes to the check-runs API (`notes/findings.md:5`). Branch protection requires `ai-review` to pass (`notes/findings.md:7`).
- The routine therefore cannot open or complete the check itself. A GitHub workflow job must keep doing it with `scripts/check_run.sh`.
- That job must map the routine's reply to a check result (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`): `200` is success, `422` is failure, and any other status is failure. If any other status counts as success, a broken review passes the gate.

**2. The App private key would leave the desktop.**
- The key has only ever been used from the desktop runner (`notes/findings.md:4`).
- Without the desktop, another runner must make the token: the NAS or a GitHub-hosted runner. That is a new place the key can leak from. Approve it as a security change first.

**3. Shared sign-in: parallel runs and expiry.**
- In the trial, two reviews started at the same moment both exited 0 on one sign-in (`notes/findings.md:3`). That proves only the exit codes. It does not prove that both reviews did real work.
- The sign-in refreshes about every 10 days. Two refreshes at the same moment can sign one session out (`notes/findings.md:4`).
- Neither workflow has a `concurrency:` group. On the desktop, reviews probably ran one at a time. That depends on the rule that one self-hosted runner runs one job at a time, which I did not verify. The cloud routine would remove that limit.
- The sign-in is "seeded at setup" (`docs/cloud-routine.md:8`). Nothing says how a refreshed sign-in is saved between sessions. A seeded copy can expire, and then every review fails until someone seeds it again.
- During the switchover, the desktop and the cloud may share the same sign-in. Their refreshes can then collide.

**4. Posting comments from the cloud is untested.**
- The routine posts the review comments itself (`docs/cloud-routine.md:6`). The proxy already blocks one GitHub write API, and the notes do not test comment writes.
- If comment posts fail, the routine may still return `200`. The check would then pass with no review on the PR.

**5. The request can block for 30 minutes on the NAS.**
- The request to the routine waits up to 30 minutes for the reply (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`). The NAS is described as a host for short jobs and HTTP calls (`README.md:23`).
- A long review holds the NAS job. If the NAS runs one job at a time, other work waits.
- The workflows set no `timeout-minutes` and no HTTP client timeout. The proxy or the client can cut the connection, and the review then shows as a failure.

**6. Existing check-run bugs get worse with long remote runs.**
- `complete` and `complete-for-pr` send a POST, so they create a second `ai-review` run. They do not update the run that `open` made (`scripts/check_run.sh:9-12`). If a job is cancelled before completion, the first run stays "in progress".
- `rerun-review.yml` reads the head commit twice, once at open and once at completion (`check_run.sh:5-7`). If someone pushes during a 30-minute review, the result goes on the new commit. A commit with no review can then pass the gate.
- When several runs on one commit share a name, the gate's outcome depends on which run GitHub counts. I could not verify that rule.

**7. Anyone who can comment can start a rerun.**
- `rerun-review.yml:8` checks only the `/rereview` prefix. It does not check who wrote the comment.
- On the cloud, each rerun uses the routine's bearer token and quota, and it adds to the sign-in collisions in risk 3.

**8. The scripts may not run on a new runner.**
- `scripts/*.sh` are stored without the execute bit (mode `100644`), and the workflows call them directly.
- A fresh runner should fail with "Permission denied". The desktop runner may be set up differently. Only a live run log can settle this.

## Smaller points
- `pr-review.yml` does not trigger on `reopened`, so a reopened PR gets no new review.
- `rerun-review.yml` checks out the default branch. This is safe only while the reviewer reads the PR by number.

## Not verified
- One self-hosted runner runs one job at a time.
- How GitHub picks between check runs with the same name on one commit.

I can check both once docs.github.com is reachable or a live workflow run is available.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Check that the reviews run off the desktop runner and start through the cloud routine.
+
+Run from the repository root: python3 tests/port_check.py
+"""
+import http.server
+import json
+import os
+import pathlib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import threading
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+WORKFLOWS = [ROOT / ".github/workflows/pr-review.yml", ROOT / ".github/workflows/rerun-review.yml"]
+START = ROOT / "scripts/start_review.sh"
+failures = []
+
+
+def check(ok, message):
+    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + message)
+    if not ok:
+        failures.append(message)
+
+
+class Routine(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    status = 200
+    requests = []
+
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0)))
+        Routine.requests.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers), "body": body,
+                                 "token_in_argv": token_in_argv()})
+        self.send_response(Routine.status)
+        self.end_headers()
+        self.wfile.write(b'{"result":"stub"}')
+
+    def log_message(self, *args):
+        pass
+
+
+def token_in_argv():
+    for cmdline in pathlib.Path("/proc").glob("[0-9]*/cmdline"):
+        try:
+            if b"secret-token" in cmdline.read_bytes():
+                return True
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return False
+
+
+def step_block(text, name):
+    start = text.index(f"- name: {name}")
+    end = text.find("- name:", start + 1)
+    return text[start:end if end != -1 else len(text)]
+
+
+def run_start(port, status, pull_request="42", model="model-x", effort="high"):
+    Routine.status = status
+    Routine.requests = []
+    env = dict(os.environ,
+               REVIEW_MODEL=model, REVIEW_EFFORT=effort,
+               CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/fire",
+               CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN="secret-token")
+    for key in ("HTTPS_PROXY", "HTTP_PROXY", "https_proxy", "http_proxy"):
+        env.pop(key, None)
+    env["NO_PROXY"] = "127.0.0.1"
+    return subprocess.run(["bash", str(START), pull_request], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
+
+
+def main():
+    for wf in WORKFLOWS:
+        text = wf.read_text()
+        check("desktop" not in text, f"{wf.name}: no desktop runner label")
+        check("runs-on: [self-hosted, nas]" in text, f"{wf.name}: runs on the NAS runner")
+        start = step_block(text, "Start reviewer")
+        check("scripts/start_review.sh" in start, f"{wf.name}: start step calls start_review.sh")
+        check("CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL: ${{ vars.CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL }}" in start, f"{wf.name}: start step gets the routine URL")
+        check("CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN }}" in start, f"{wf.name}: start step gets the routine token")
+        complete = step_block(text, "Complete check run")
+        check("scripts/check_run.sh" in step_block(text, "Open check run")
+              and "scripts/check_run.sh" in complete,
+              f"{wf.name}: still opens and completes the check run")
+        check("if: always()" in complete, f"{wf.name}: completes the check run even when the review fails")
+
+    readme = (ROOT / "README.md").read_text()
+    check("desktop" not in readme.lower(), "README no longer describes the desktop runner")
+    check("CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL" in readme, "README names the cloud routine")
+    code = [line.split("#", 1)[0] for line in START.read_text().splitlines() if not line.lstrip().startswith("#")]
+    timeouts = [line for line in code if "--max-time" in line]
+    check(len(timeouts) == 1 and "--max-time 1860" in timeouts[0],
+          f"start_review.sh bounds the POST just past 30 minutes: {timeouts!r}")
+
+    modes = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "-s", "scripts"], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    for line in modes.splitlines():
+        check(line.startswith("100755"), f"executable in git: {line.split()[-1]}")
+
+    server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Routine)
+    port = server.server_address[1]
+    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
+
+    result = run_start(port, 200)
+    check(result.returncode == 0, f"200 passes (exit {result.returncode}, stderr {result.stderr.strip()!r})")
+    check(len(Routine.requests) == 1, "one POST per review")
+    if Routine.requests:
+        request = Routine.requests[0]
+        check(request["path"] == "/fire", "POST goes to CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL")
+        check(request["headers"].get("Authorization") == "Bearer secret-token", "bearer token sent")
+        try:
+            body = json.loads(request["body"])
+        except ValueError:
+            body = None
+        check(body == {"pull_request": 42, "model": "model-x", "effort": "high"}, f"JSON body is correct: {request['body']!r}")
+        check(not request["token_in_argv"], "token is not in any process command line")
+    check('{"result":"stub"}' in result.stdout, "response body is printed")
+
+    result = run_start(port, 200, pull_request="7", model="other-model", effort="low")
+    body = json.loads(Routine.requests[0]["body"]) if Routine.requests else None
+    check(body == {"pull_request": 7, "model": "other-model", "effort": "low"}, "body follows the inputs")
+
+    for bad in (("4 2", "m", "e"), ("08", "m", "e"), ("010", "m", "e"), ("42", 'm"x', "e"), ("42", "m", "e\\")):
+        result = run_start(port, 200, *bad)
+        check(result.returncode != 0 and not Routine.requests, f"rejects unsafe input {bad!r} before any POST")
+
+    result = run_start(port, 422)
+    check(result.returncode != 0, "422 (blocking findings) fails")
+    check("blocking findings" in result.stdout + result.stderr, "422 says blocking findings")
+    for status in (500, 401, 204):
+        result = run_start(port, status)
+        check(result.returncode != 0, f"{status} (routine failed) fails")
+
+    server.shutdown()
+    server.server_close()
+    result = run_start(port, 200)
+    check(result.returncode != 0, "unreachable routine fails")
+
+    print(f"\n{len(failures)} failure(s)")
+    sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

meta.prior_reply:
I read all seven files in the repo. A separate verifier agent checked my 12 risk claims against the files and confirmed all of them. It also found several more, which are included below. Points marked **[GH]** depend on how GitHub behaves in general, not on anything in the repo. I did not edit any files.

## Biggest risks

1. **The one shared sign-in.** The cloud routine runs every review on one sign-in that was set up once (`docs/cloud-routine.md:8`). That sign-in refreshes about every 10 days, and two refreshes at the same moment can sign a session out (`notes/findings.md:2`). Neither workflow has a `concurrency:` group, so overlapping reviews will happen (`.github/workflows/pr-review.yml`, `.github/workflows/rerun-review.yml`). Two quick pushes are enough, or a push plus a `/rereview`. If the sign-in is lost, every review fails until someone sets it up again.
2. **Exit 0 does not prove the reviews worked.** In the trial, two reviews at once both "finished with exit 0" (`notes/findings.md:3`). The notes do not say whether either review was correct.
3. **The routine cannot set the `ai-review` check.** The cloud proxy blocks writes to the check-runs API (`notes/findings.md:3`). So some job on a runner, or a commit status, must still set `ai-review`. Branch protection requires that check (`notes/findings.md:5`). If it never finishes, merges are blocked. If it passes by mistake, unreviewed code can merge.
4. **A failed review can show as a pass.** The routine returns 200 for a pass and 422 for blocking findings (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`). The workflow sets the check result from `${{ job.status }}` (`pr-review.yml:27`). A `curl` call without `-f` exits 0 on a 422, so the check would show `success`. With `-f`, blocking findings and a broken routine both show as `failure`, and nobody can tell them apart.
5. **No runner fits well.** The NAS is for "Short jobs and HTTP calls" (`README.md:23`), but the POST can stay open for up to 30 minutes (`docs/cloud-routine.md:7`). If the NAS or a proxy drops a long idle connection, the job fails while the cloud review keeps going and still posts comments. GitHub-hosted runners are not listed in the README. Nobody has tried them.

## Correctness risks that a longer wait makes worse

6. **The check can land on a commit nobody reviewed.** The reviewer gets only the PR number (`scripts/start_review.sh:3-7`, `docs/cloud-routine.md:6`). The check goes on a SHA that is looked up separately. `rerun-review.yml` looks up the head SHA once when it opens the check and again when it completes it (`scripts/check_run.sh:5-12`). `pr-review.yml` uses the SHA from the event. A push during the review can put the result on a commit that was not reviewed, and a 30-minute wait makes that window much wider.
7. **The last review to finish decides the check.** `complete` sends a POST that creates a new check run. It never updates the one that is `in_progress` (`scripts/check_run.sh:11-12`). **[GH]** GitHub reads the newest run with a given name. So an older review that finishes late can replace the result for a newer commit.
8. **Cancelling the job does not stop the cloud review.** **[GH]** If you add `cancel-in-progress` to fix item 1, a cancelled job leaves its POST running. The review still posts comments and still uses the shared sign-in.

## Security and access

9. **Anyone who can comment can start a review.** The `/rereview` filter checks only the start of the comment (`rerun-review.yml:8`). It does not check who wrote it, and `/rereviewxyz` also matches. Each cloud run puts more load on the one sign-in.
10. **PR code runs with the secrets.** `pr-review.yml` checks out the PR and then runs that PR's own copy of `scripts/check_run.sh` with the App token. Someone with a branch in this repo can edit that script to report `success`. After the move, `CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN` would be exposed the same way.
11. **The App key has only been used from the desktop** (`notes/findings.md:4`). **[GH]** The secret reaches every runner the same way. The parts nobody has tested are the token action's runtime on a new runner and that runner's network path to GitHub.

## Cutover and fallback

12. **There is no fallback.** The desktop is the only listed runner that can run the reviewer CLI (`README.md:22-23`). If the routine fails, nothing else can review.
13. **Jobs can get stuck during the switch.** **[GH]** If the desktop goes offline before `runs-on` changes, queued jobs wait about 24 hours and then fail. No check appears, so merges are blocked.
14. **Smaller issues:**
    - **[GH]** The App token lasts about one hour, so 30 minutes leaves little room if the runner queue is slow.
    - If opening the check fails, the review still runs and nobody is told.
    - **[GH]** Fork PRs get no secrets, so no check appears and the merge stays blocked. This happens today and the move does not change it.

One note on the setup: `.claude/rules/index.md` links to 16 rule guides, but only `verified-work.md` is in the repo.

The risks I would deal with before anything else are 1, 3, 4 and 6. When you want changes, tell me which of these to fix.

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud review routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for it.
+# Exit 0 when the review passed, 1 on blocking findings or routine failure.
+# A 5xx status is retried once.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+model=${REVIEW_MODEL:?}
+effort=${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}
+case "$model$effort" in
+  *'"'* | *'\'*) echo "REVIEW_MODEL and REVIEW_EFFORT must not contain quotes or backslashes" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+esac
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%d,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort")
+
+post() {
+  # The token goes on stdin so it stays out of the process list.
+  printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" |
+    curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' \
+      --max-time "${ROUTINE_MAX_TIME:-1900}" \
+      --header @- --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+      --data-binary "$body" "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" || true
+}
+
+status=$(post)
+echo "routine returned $status"
+if [[ $status == 5?? ]]; then
+  echo "retrying once after $status"
+  status=$(post)
+  echo "routine returned $status"
+fi
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "review reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "routine failed with status $status" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/call_routine.sh against a local fake routine that answers
+# with a scripted list of status codes, one per request.
+set -uo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat >"$work/server.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys, time
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        with open(f"{work}/requests", "a") as f:
+            f.write(json.dumps({"auth": self.headers.get("Authorization"),
+                                "body": json.loads(body)}) + "\n")
+        codes = open(f"{work}/codes").read().split()
+        code = codes.pop(0)
+        open(f"{work}/codes", "w").write(" ".join(codes))
+        if code == "hang":
+            time.sleep(5)
+            code = "200"
+        self.send_response(int(code))
+        self.end_headers()
+    def log_message(self, *a):
+        pass
+s = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+open(f"{work}/port", "w").write(str(s.server_port))
+s.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 "$work/server.py" "$work" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$work/port")/run"
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=test-token
+export REVIEW_MODEL=test-model
+export REVIEW_EFFORT=high
+export ROUTINE_MAX_TIME=2
+
+failures=0
+# check <name> <codes> <want-exit> <want-requests>
+check() {
+  echo "$2" >"$work/codes"
+  : >"$work/requests"
+  "$repo/scripts/call_routine.sh" 42 >/dev/null 2>&1
+  got_exit=$?
+  got_requests=$(wc -l <"$work/requests")
+  if [ "$got_exit" = "$3" ] && [ "$got_requests" = "$4" ]; then
+    echo "PASS $1"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL $1: exit $got_exit (want $3), requests $got_requests (want $4)"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+}
+
+check "200 passes"                    "200"     0 1
+check "422 fails, no retry"           "422"     1 1
+check "400 fails, no retry"           "400"     1 1
+check "503 then 200 passes"           "503 200" 0 2
+check "500 then 422 fails"            "500 422" 1 2
+check "503 twice fails after 1 retry" "503 503 200" 1 2
+check "timeout fails, no retry"       "hang 200" 1 1
+
+echo "200" >"$work/codes"; : >"$work/requests"
+"$repo/scripts/call_routine.sh" 42 >/dev/null 2>&1
+want='{"auth": "Bearer test-token", "body": {"pull_request": 42, "model": "test-model", "effort": "high"}}'
+if [ "$(cat "$work/requests")" = "$want" ]; then echo "PASS request body and auth"; else
+  echo "FAIL request body and auth: $(cat "$work/requests")"; failures=$((failures + 1)); fi
+
+echo "200" >"$work/codes"; : >"$work/requests"
+REVIEW_MODEL='bad"model' "$repo/scripts/call_routine.sh" 42 >/dev/null 2>&1
+got_exit=$?
+if [ "$got_exit" = 2 ] && [ ! -s "$work/requests" ]; then echo "PASS quote in model is refused"; else
+  echo "FAIL quote in model is refused: exit $got_exit (want 2)"; failures=$((failures + 1)); fi
+
+[ "$failures" = 0 ] && echo "ALL PASS" || { echo "$failures FAILED"; exit 1; }

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud review routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for the result.
+# Exits 0 when the review passed (200) and 1 otherwise. Retries once on a 5xx status.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+model=${REVIEW_MODEL:?}
+effort=${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}
+for value in "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort"; do
+  [[ $value =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$ ]] || { echo "unsafe value: $value" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+[[ $pull_request_number =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "bad pull request number" >&2; exit 2; }
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort")
+
+fire() {
+  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 -X POST \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+    --data "$body" "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" || true
+}
+
+status=$(fire)
+if [[ $status =~ ^5[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
+  echo "routine returned $status, retrying once" >&2
+  sleep "${RETRY_DELAY:-30}"
+  status=$(fire)
+fi
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "reviewer reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "routine failed with status $status" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/call_routine.sh against a local mock routine.
+# Each case gives the status codes the mock returns, in order, and the
+# expected exit code and request count of the script.
+set -uo pipefail
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; find "$work" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/mock.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        with open(f"{work}/statuses") as f:
+            statuses = f.read().split()
+        with open(f"{work}/count") as f:
+            n = int(f.read() or 0)
+        with open(f"{work}/count", "w") as f:
+            f.write(str(n + 1))
+        with open(f"{work}/last", "w") as f:
+            json.dump({"auth": self.headers["Authorization"], "body": json.loads(body)}, f)
+        self.send_response(int(statuses[min(n, len(statuses) - 1)]))
+        self.end_headers()
+    def log_message(self, *a): pass
+s = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+print(s.server_port, flush=True)
+s.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 -I "$work/mock.py" "$work" > "$work/port" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$work/port")/fire"
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=test-token REVIEW_MODEL=test-model REVIEW_EFFORT=high
+export RETRY_DELAY=0
+
+failures=0
+check() {
+  local statuses=$1 want_exit=$2 want_calls=$3
+  echo "$statuses" > "$work/statuses"
+  : > "$work/count"
+  timeout 10 "$root/scripts/call_routine.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+  local got_exit=$? got_calls
+  got_calls=$(cat "$work/count")
+  if [ "$got_exit" = "$want_exit" ] && [ "$got_calls" = "$want_calls" ]; then
+    echo "PASS [$statuses] exit=$got_exit calls=$got_calls"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL [$statuses] exit=$got_exit (want $want_exit) calls=$got_calls (want $want_calls)"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+}
+
+check "200"     0 1   # review passed
+check "422"     1 1   # blocking findings: no retry
+check "503 200" 0 2   # 5xx then pass: one retry
+check "500 422" 1 2   # 5xx then blocking findings
+check "502 504" 1 2   # 5xx twice: only one retry
+check "404"     1 1   # other failure: no retry
+check "401 200" 1 1   # 4xx is not retried
+
+want='{"auth":"Bearer test-token","body":{"pull_request":42,"model":"test-model","effort":"high"}}'
+if [ "$(jq -cS . "$work/last")" = "$(jq -cS . <<< "$want")" ]; then
+  echo "PASS request body and auth"
+else
+  echo "FAIL request body and auth: $(cat "$work/last")"
+  failures=$((failures + 1))
+fi
+
+[ "$failures" = 0 ]

(1) Run only one routine call at a time, so two sessions cannot refresh the shared sign-in at the same moment (notes/findings.md #2). A naive GitHub concurrency group cancels queued runs and can leave the required check missing. (2) Rerun workflow: open and complete the check on one fixed head SHA. A push during the 30-minute call can leave the check stuck in_progress. (3) Let only collaborators trigger /rereview. Today any commenter can fire the paid routine call. (4) Delete scripts/start_review.sh, which nothing uses after the port. Which of these should I add?

judge_verdict.reason: The session ported both workflows to the NAS runner, added the one-retry cloud script, a test and README updates, and only asked about the four extras on a card without building them.

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud review routine and waits for its verdict (docs/cloud-routine.md).
+# Exits 0 when the review passed, 1 otherwise. Retries once on a 5xx status.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+[[ "$pull_request_number" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "bad pull request number: $pull_request_number" >&2; exit 2; }
+for value in "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}"; do
+  [[ "$value" != *[\"\\]* ]] || { echo "model and effort must not contain quotes or backslashes" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' \
+  "$pull_request_number" "$REVIEW_MODEL" "$REVIEW_EFFORT")
+
+fire() {
+  # The routine holds the request open for up to 30 minutes.
+  curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' \
+    --max-time 1860 \
+    -X POST "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d "$body" || true
+}
+
+status=$(fire)
+if [[ "$status" == 5?? ]]; then
+  echo "routine returned $status, retrying once" >&2
+  status=$(fire)
+fi
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "reviewer reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "routine failed with status $status" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Checks scripts/start_cloud_review.sh against a stubbed curl.
+# Each case lists the HTTP codes the stub returns, in call order.
+set -uo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+
+mkdir -p "$work/bin"
+cat > "$work/bin/curl" <<'EOF'
+#!/bin/bash
+# Record the call, then print the next queued status code.
+printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$STUB_DIR/calls"
+read -r code < "$STUB_DIR/codes"
+sed -i '1d' "$STUB_DIR/codes"
+printf '%s' "$code"
+EOF
+chmod +x "$work/bin/curl"
+
+failures=0
+run_case() {
+  local name=$1 want_exit=$2 want_calls=$3
+  shift 3
+  : > "$work/calls"
+  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$work/codes"
+  PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" STUB_DIR="$work" \
+    CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.example/fire CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t \
+    REVIEW_MODEL=m REVIEW_EFFORT=e \
+    "$repo/scripts/start_cloud_review.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+  local got_exit=$? got_calls
+  got_calls=$(wc -l < "$work/calls")
+  if [ "$got_exit" -ne "$want_exit" ] || [ "$got_calls" -ne "$want_calls" ]; then
+    echo "FAIL $name: exit $got_exit (want $want_exit), calls $got_calls (want $want_calls)"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  else
+    echo "ok   $name"
+  fi
+}
+
+run_case "200 passes"                 0 1 200
+run_case "422 fails, no retry"        1 1 422
+run_case "500 then 200 passes"        0 2 500 200
+run_case "502 then 503 fails"         1 2 502 503
+run_case "503 then 422 fails"         1 2 503 422
+run_case "404 fails, no retry"        1 1 404
+run_case "timeout 000 fails, no retry" 1 1 000
+
+# The request must carry the bearer token and the JSON body.
+: > "$work/calls"; printf '200\n' > "$work/codes"
+PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" STUB_DIR="$work" \
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.example/fire CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t \
+  REVIEW_MODEL=m REVIEW_EFFORT=e \
+  "$repo/scripts/start_cloud_review.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+call=$(cat "$work/calls")
+for want in 'Authorization: Bearer t' '"pull_request":42' '"model":"m"' '"effort":"e"' 'https://routine.example/fire'; do
+  if [[ "$call" != *"$want"* ]]; then
+    echo "FAIL request missing $want"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+done
+[ "$failures" -eq 0 ] && echo "request ok"
+
+exit "$failures"

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for the review.
+# 200 = review passed, 422 = blocking findings, anything else = routine failed.
+# A 5xx status is retried once.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+model=${REVIEW_MODEL:?}
+effort=${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}
+: "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}"
+
+# Values go into the JSON body without escaping, so allow only safe characters.
+[[ $pull_request_number =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "bad pull request number: $pull_request_number" >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $model =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$ ]] || { echo "bad REVIEW_MODEL: $model" >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $effort =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || { echo "bad REVIEW_EFFORT: $effort" >&2; exit 2; }
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort")
+
+response=$(mktemp)
+trap 'rm -f "$response"' EXIT
+
+call_routine() {
+  # The routine holds the request open for up to 30 minutes.
+  curl --silent --show-error --max-time 1860 \
+    --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
+    --request POST "$CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL" \
+    --header "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN" \
+    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+    --data "$body" || true
+}
+
+status=$(call_routine)
+if [[ $status =~ ^5[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
+  echo "cloud routine returned $status; retrying once" >&2
+  : > "$response"
+  status=$(call_routine)
+fi
+
+cat "$response" 2>/dev/null || true
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "review reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "cloud routine failed with status $status" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Checks scripts/start_cloud_review.sh against a stub curl.
+# Each case lists the HTTP statuses the stub returns, in call order.
+set -uo pipefail
+here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/curl" <<'STUB'
+#!/bin/bash
+n=$(( $(cat "$STUB_DIR/calls" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 ))
+echo "$n" > "$STUB_DIR/calls"
+printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_DIR/args.$n"
+status=$(echo "$STUB_STATUSES" | cut -d' ' -f"$n")
+printf '%s' "${status:-500}"
+STUB
+chmod +x "$work/curl"
+
+failures=0
+run_case() {
+  local name=$1 statuses=$2 want_exit=$3 want_calls=$4
+  : > "$work/calls"; echo 0 > "$work/calls"
+  PATH="$work:$PATH" STUB_DIR="$work" STUB_STATUSES="$statuses" \
+    CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.example/fire CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t \
+    REVIEW_MODEL=m REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+    "$here/start_cloud_review.sh" 42 >/dev/null 2>&1
+  local got_exit=$? got_calls
+  got_calls=$(cat "$work/calls")
+  if [ "$want_exit" = nonzero ] && [ "$got_exit" -ne 0 ]; then got_exit=nonzero; fi
+  if [ "$got_exit" = "$want_exit" ] && [ "$got_calls" = "$want_calls" ]; then
+    echo "PASS $name"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL $name: exit=$got_exit (want $want_exit) calls=$got_calls (want $want_calls)"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+}
+
+run_case "200 passes"                 "200"     0       1
+run_case "422 fails, no retry"        "422"     nonzero 1
+run_case "404 fails, no retry"        "404"     nonzero 1
+run_case "500 then 200 passes"        "500 200" 0       2
+run_case "503 then 422 fails"         "503 422" nonzero 2
+run_case "502 twice fails, one retry" "502 502" nonzero 2
+
+if grep -q '"pull_request":42' "$work/args.1" && grep -q 'Bearer t' "$work/args.1"; then
+  echo "PASS request body and auth"
+else
+  echo "FAIL request body and auth"; failures=$((failures + 1))
+fi
+
+exit "$failures"

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud review routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for the result.
+# Exits 0 when the review passed, 1 otherwise. Retries once on a 5xx status.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+[[ "$pull_request_number" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "bad pull request number: $pull_request_number" >&2; exit 2; }
+: "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}"
+for value in "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}"; do
+  [[ "$value" != *[\"\\]* ]] || { echo "REVIEW_MODEL and REVIEW_EFFORT must not contain quotes or backslashes" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+work_dir=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
+printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' \
+  "$pull_request_number" "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}" > "$work_dir/body.json"
+
+post() {
+  # The token goes through stdin so it stays out of the process list.
+  printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" | curl -sS \
+    --max-time "${ROUTINE_MAX_TIME:-1900}" \
+    -o "$work_dir/response" -w '%{http_code}' \
+    -X POST -H @- -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+    --data-binary "@$work_dir/body.json" \
+    "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" || true
+}
+
+status=$(post)
+if [[ "$status" == 5?? ]]; then
+  echo "routine returned $status; retrying once" >&2
+  status=$(post)
+fi
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "review reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "routine failed with status $status" >&2; cat "$work_dir/response" >&2 2>/dev/null || true; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/call_routine.sh against a local stub routine.
+# Usage: tests/call_routine_test.sh
+set -uo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work_dir=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work_dir/stub.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class Stub(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        with open(f"{work}/requests", "a") as log:
+            log.write(json.dumps({"auth": self.headers["Authorization"], "body": body.decode()}) + "\n")
+        with open(f"{work}/statuses") as f:
+            statuses = f.read().split()
+        count = sum(1 for _ in open(f"{work}/requests"))
+        self.send_response(int(statuses[min(count, len(statuses)) - 1]))
+        self.end_headers()
+        self.wfile.write(b"stub response")
+    def log_message(self, *args):
+        pass
+server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Stub)
+print(server.server_port, flush=True)
+server.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 -u "$work_dir/stub.py" "$work_dir" > "$work_dir/port" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work_dir/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+port=$(cat "$work_dir/port")
+
+failures=0
+# check <statuses> <expected exit> <expected request count>
+check() {
+  echo "$1" > "$work_dir/statuses"
+  : > "$work_dir/requests"
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=secret-token \
+    REVIEW_MODEL=model-x REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+    "$repo/scripts/call_routine.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+  local code=$? calls
+  calls=$(wc -l < "$work_dir/requests")
+  if [ "$code" -eq "$2" ] && [ "$calls" -eq "$3" ]; then
+    echo "PASS [$1] exit=$code calls=$calls"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL [$1] exit=$code (want $2) calls=$calls (want $3)"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+}
+
+check "200" 0 1
+check "422" 1 1
+check "404" 1 1
+check "503 200" 0 2
+check "500 422" 1 2
+check "502 503 200" 1 2
+
+# The request carries the token and the contract fields.
+want='{"auth": "Bearer secret-token", "body": "{\"pull_request\":42,\"model\":\"model-x\",\"effort\":\"high\"}"}'
+if [ "$(head -n 1 "$work_dir/requests")" = "$want" ]; then
+  echo "PASS request shape"
+else
+  echo "FAIL request shape: $(head -n 1 "$work_dir/requests")"
+  failures=$((failures + 1))
+fi
+
+# Bad settings stop the script before any request.
+# refuse <description> <env assignments...>
+refuse() {
+  local description=$1 code calls
+  shift
+  : > "$work_dir/requests"
+  env CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=secret-token \
+    REVIEW_MODEL=model-x REVIEW_EFFORT=high "$@" \
+    "$repo/scripts/call_routine.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+  code=$?
+  calls=$(wc -l < "$work_dir/requests")
+  if [ "$code" -ne 0 ] && [ "$calls" -eq 0 ]; then
+    echo "PASS refuses $description"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL refuses $description: exit=$code calls=$calls"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+}
+echo "200" > "$work_dir/statuses"
+refuse "empty token" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=
+refuse "quote in model" 'REVIEW_MODEL=a"b'
+
+echo "failures: $failures"
+[ "$failures" -eq 0 ]

+  --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+  --arg model "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" \

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/run_cloud_review.sh against a stub routine that answers with a
+# scripted list of statuses, and checks the exit code and the number of calls.
+set -uo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+script=${SCRIPT_UNDER_TEST:-$repo/scripts/run_cloud_review.sh}
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -r -- "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/stub.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+statuses_file, calls_file, port_file = sys.argv[1:4]
+class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
+        assert self.headers["Authorization"] == "Bearer test-token"
+        assert body == {"pull_request": 7, "model": "m", "effort": "e"}, body
+        with open(statuses_file) as f:
+            statuses = f.read().split()
+        with open(calls_file, "a") as f:
+            f.write("x")
+        with open(calls_file) as f:
+            n = len(f.read())
+        self.send_response(int(statuses[min(n, len(statuses)) - 1]))
+        self.end_headers()
+    def log_message(self, *args):
+        pass
+server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+with open(port_file, "w") as f:
+    f.write(str(server.server_port))
+server.serve_forever()
+EOF
+
+python3 "$work/stub.py" "$work/statuses" "$work/calls" "$work/port" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [[ -s $work/port ]] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+
+failures=0
+check() {
+  local statuses=$1 want_exit=$2 want_calls=$3
+  echo "$statuses" > "$work/statuses"
+  : > "$work/calls"
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$work/port")/" \
+    CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=test-token REVIEW_MODEL=m REVIEW_EFFORT=e \
+    "$script" 7 >/dev/null 2>&1
+  local got_exit=$? got_calls
+  got_calls=$(wc -c < "$work/calls")
+  if [[ $got_exit == "$want_exit" && $got_calls == "$want_calls" ]]; then
+    echo "ok   [$statuses] exit=$got_exit calls=$got_calls"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL [$statuses] exit=$got_exit calls=$got_calls, want exit=$want_exit calls=$want_calls"
+    failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+}

+check "200"         0 1
+check "422"         1 1
+check "404"         1 1
+check "502 200"     0 2
+check "500 422"     1 2
+check "503 503 200" 1 2
+check "429 200"     1 1
+
+exit $((failures > 0))

+#!/bin/bash
+# Checks that start_review.sh passes REVIEW_DEPTH through and rejects bad values.
+# A stub `reviewer` on PATH records its arguments instead of running a review.
+set -uo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+stub=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'find "$stub" -delete' EXIT
+printf '#!/bin/bash\necho "$*" > "%s/args"\n' "$stub" > "$stub/reviewer"
+chmod +x "$stub/reviewer"
+failures=0
+
+run() {
+  find "$stub" -name args -delete
+  env -u REVIEW_DEPTH PATH="$stub:$PATH" REVIEW_MODEL=m "$@" \
+    bash "$repo/scripts/start_review.sh" 42 >/dev/null 2>&1
+}
+
+for depth in low medium high; do
+  if run REVIEW_DEPTH="$depth" && grep -q -- "--effort $depth " "$stub/args"; then
+    echo "ok: accepts $depth"
+  else
+    echo "FAIL: accepts $depth"; failures=$((failures + 1))
+  fi
+done
+
+for depth in "" LOW max "low " xhigh; do
+  if run REVIEW_DEPTH="$depth" || [ -e "$stub/args" ]; then
+    echo "FAIL: rejects '$depth'"; failures=$((failures + 1))
+  else
+    echo "ok: rejects '$depth'"
+  fi
+done
+
+if run || [ -e "$stub/args" ]; then
+  echo "FAIL: rejects unset"; failures=$((failures + 1))
+else
+  echo "ok: rejects unset"
+fi
+
+exit "$failures"

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+case "$pull_request_number" in
+  ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "pull request number must be numeric: $pull_request_number" >&2; exit 2 ;;
+esac
+for value in "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}"; do
+  if [[ ! "$value" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$ ]]; then
+    echo "REVIEW_MODEL and REVIEW_EFFORT may hold only letters, digits, and . _ : -" >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+done
+payload=$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' \
+  "$pull_request_number" "$REVIEW_MODEL" "$REVIEW_EFFORT")
+
+# The routine holds the request open until the review ends, up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(curl --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' \
+  --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  --data "$payload" \
+  "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}") || status=000
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) result='passed'; exit_code=0 ;;
+  422) result='found blocking issues. See the review comments'; exit_code=1 ;;
+  *) result="failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP $status"; exit_code=1 ;;
+esac
+run_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pull_request_number/comments" \
+  -f body="**ai-review** $result. ([run]($run_url))"
+exit "$exit_code"

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/cloud_review.sh against stub curl and gh for each routine status.
+set -uo pipefail
+repo_root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -r -- "$work"' EXIT
+mkdir "$work/bin"
+cat > "$work/bin/curl" <<'EOF'
+#!/bin/bash
+printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_DIR/curl.args"
+if [ "$STUB_STATUS" = fail ]; then printf '000'; exit 7; fi
+printf '%s' "$STUB_STATUS"
+EOF
+cat > "$work/bin/gh" <<'EOF'
+#!/bin/bash
+printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_DIR/gh.args"
+EOF
+chmod +x "$work/bin/curl" "$work/bin/gh"
+
+failures=0
+check() {
+  local stub_status=$1 want_exit=$2 want_text=$3
+  rm -f -- "$work/gh.args" "$work/curl.args"
+  PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" STUB_DIR="$work" STUB_STATUS="$stub_status" \
+    REVIEW_MODEL=model-x REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+    CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.example/fire CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=secret \
+    GITHUB_REPOSITORY=owner/repo GITHUB_SERVER_URL=https://github.com GITHUB_RUN_ID=99 \
+    "$repo_root/scripts/cloud_review.sh" 42 >/dev/null 2>&1
+  local got_exit=$?
+  if [ "$got_exit" != "$want_exit" ]; then
+    echo "FAIL $stub_status: exit $got_exit, want $want_exit"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if ! grep -qF -- "$want_text" "$work/gh.args" 2>/dev/null; then
+    echo "FAIL $stub_status: comment lacks '$want_text'"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if ! grep -qF 'repos/owner/repo/issues/42/comments' "$work/gh.args"; then
+    echo "FAIL $stub_status: comment not posted to pull request 42"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if ! grep -qF '{"pull_request":42,"model":"model-x","effort":"high"}' "$work/curl.args"; then
+    echo "FAIL $stub_status: wrong routine payload"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if grep -qF 'check-runs' "$work/gh.args"; then
+    echo "FAIL $stub_status: check run API used"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  echo "ok   $stub_status"
+}
+
+check 200 0 '**ai-review** passed'
+check 422 1 '**ai-review** found blocking issues'
+check 500 1 'returned HTTP 500'
+check fail 1 'returned HTTP 000'
+exit "$failures"

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+status=000
+if request=$(jq -n \
+  --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+  --arg model "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" \
+  --arg effort "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}" \
+  '{pull_request: $pull_request, model: $model, effort: $effort}'); then

+  status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+    -X POST \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+    -d "$request" \
+    "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}") || status=000
+fi
+case "$status" in
+  200) result=passed; message="✅ **AI review passed.**" ;;
+  422) result=blocked; message="❌ **AI review found blocking findings.** See the review comments on this pull request." ;;
+  *) result=error; message="⚠️ **AI review did not run.** The cloud routine returned HTTP $status." ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/cloud_review.sh against a stub curl for each routine status.
+set -uo pipefail
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
+mkdir "$work/bin"
+cat >"$work/bin/curl" <<'EOF'
+#!/bin/bash
+for arg in "$@"; do last=$arg; done
+if [[ "$last" == */comments ]]; then
+  cat >"$STUB_DIR/comment.json"
+  echo "$last" >"$STUB_DIR/comment_url"
+  exit 0
+fi
+printf '%s' "$@" >"$STUB_DIR/routine_args"
+[ "$STUB_STATUS" = fail ] && exit 7
+printf '%s' "$STUB_STATUS"
+EOF
+chmod +x "$work/bin/curl"
+
+failures=0
+check() {
+  local stub_status=$1 want_exit=$2 want_text=$3 model=${4-m}
+  rm -f "$work/comment.json" "$work/comment_url"
+  PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" STUB_DIR="$work" STUB_STATUS="$stub_status" \
+    REVIEW_MODEL="$model" REVIEW_EFFORT=e CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.example \
+    CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t GH_TOKEN=g GITHUB_REPOSITORY=o/r \
+    GITHUB_SERVER_URL=https://github.com GITHUB_RUN_ID=1 \

+  local got_exit=$?
+  local body

+  if [ "$want_exit" = 0 ] && [ "$got_exit" != 0 ] || [ "$want_exit" != 0 ] && [ "$got_exit" = 0 ]; then
+    echo "FAIL status=$stub_status: exit $got_exit"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if [[ "$body" != *"$want_text"* ]]; then
+    echo "FAIL status=$stub_status: comment body '$body'"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if [ "$(cat "$work/comment_url")" != "https://api.github.com/repos/o/r/issues/42/comments" ]; then
+    echo "FAIL status=$stub_status: comment url"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  echo "ok   status=$stub_status"

+check 422 1 "blocking findings"
+check 500 1 "returned HTTP 500"
+check fail 1 "did not run"
+check 200 1 "returned HTTP 000" ""

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+fire_routine() {
+  local name body
+  for name in CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN REVIEW_MODEL REVIEW_EFFORT; do
+    if [ -z "${!name:-}" ]; then
+      echo "missing $name"
+      return
+    fi
+  done
+  body=$(jq -n \
+    --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+    --arg model "$REVIEW_MODEL" \
+    --arg effort "$REVIEW_EFFORT" \
+    '{pull_request: $pull_request, model: $model, effort: $effort}')
+  # The routine holds the request open until the review finishes, up to 30 minutes.
+  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+    -X POST "$CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL" \
+    -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN" \
+    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+    -d "$body" || true
+}
+status=$(fire_routine)
+case "$status" in
+  200) result="passed"; exit_code=0 ;;
+  422) result="found blocking issues"; exit_code=1 ;;
+  missing*) result="failed: the workflow is $status"; exit_code=1 ;;
+  *) result="failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP ${status:-000}"; exit_code=1 ;;
+esac
+gh pr comment "$pull_request_number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+  --body "**ai-review** $result. [Run log]($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID)"
+exit "$exit_code"

+while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do [ "$1" = -d ] && printf '%s' "$2" > "$STUB_DIR/curl_body"; shift; done
+[ "$STUB_STATUS" = fail ] && exit 7
+printf '%s' "$STUB_STATUS"
+EOF

+#!/bin/bash
+printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_DIR/gh_args"

+  STUB_DIR=$stubs STUB_STATUS=$status PATH="$stubs:$PATH" \

+    REVIEW_MODEL=$model REVIEW_EFFORT=high GITHUB_REPOSITORY=o/r \

+  if [ "$got_exit" != "$want_exit" ]; then
+    echo "FAIL $status: exit $got_exit, want $want_exit"; failures=$((failures+1)); return
+  fi
+  if ! grep -qF "$want_text" "$stubs/gh_args" 2>/dev/null; then
+    echo "FAIL $status: comment lacks '$want_text'"; failures=$((failures+1)); return
+  fi
+  if [ -z "$model" ]; then
+    [ ! -e "$stubs/curl_args" ] && echo "ok   $status" && return
+    echo "FAIL $status: curl ran without config"; failures=$((failures+1)); return
+  fi
+  for want in POST https://routine.example/fire 'Authorization: Bearer tok' 1860; do
+    if ! grep -qxF -- "$want" "$stubs/curl_args"; then
+      echo "FAIL $status: curl args lack '$want'"; failures=$((failures+1)); return
+    fi
+  done

+    echo "FAIL $status: request body is wrong"; failures=$((failures+1)); return
+  fi
+  echo "ok   $status"

+

+check 422 1 "**ai-review** found blocking issues."
+check 500 1 "**ai-review** failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP 500."
+check fail 1 "**ai-review** failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP 000."
+check missing-model 1 "**ai-review** failed: the workflow is missing REVIEW_MODEL." ""

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+model=${REVIEW_MODEL:?}
+effort=${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}
+[[ $pull_request_number =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "bad pull request number: $pull_request_number" >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $model =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$ ]] || { echo "bad REVIEW_MODEL: $model" >&2; exit 2; }
+[[ $effort =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$ ]] || { echo "bad REVIEW_EFFORT: $effort" >&2; exit 2; }
+
+# The routine holds the POST open until the review ends, up to 30 minutes.
+request=$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort")
+status=$(curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$request" \
+  "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}") || status=000
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) result="passed"; exit_code=0 ;;
+  422) result="reported blocking findings"; exit_code=1 ;;
+  *) result="failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP $status"; exit_code=1 ;;
+esac
+
+run_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+comment=$(printf '{"body":"**AI review %s.** [Workflow run](%s)"}' "$result" "$run_url")
+curl --silent --show-error --fail --output /dev/null \
+  -X POST \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
+  --data "$comment" \
+  "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pull_request_number/comments"
+
+echo "AI review $result"
+exit "$exit_code"

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/request_review.sh against a stub curl for each routine status.
+set -euo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -r -- "$work"' EXIT
+
+mkdir "$work/bin"
+cat > "$work/bin/curl" <<'STUB'
+#!/bin/bash
+printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$STUB_LOG"
+for arg in "$@"; do
+  case "$arg" in
+    */issues/*/comments) exit 0 ;;
+  esac
+done
+printf '%s' "$STUB_STATUS"
+# Real curl exits non-zero when it gets no HTTP response.
+[[ $STUB_STATUS != 000 ]] || exit 7
+STUB
+chmod +x "$work/bin/curl"
+
+export PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" STUB_LOG="$work/log"
+export REVIEW_MODEL=m1 REVIEW_EFFORT=high CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.test/run CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=t GH_TOKEN=g
+export GITHUB_SERVER_URL=https://github.com GITHUB_API_URL=https://api.github.com GITHUB_REPOSITORY=o/r GITHUB_RUN_ID=9
+
+failures=0
+check() {
+  local status=$1 want_exit=$2 want_text=$3
+  : > "$STUB_LOG"
+  local got_exit=0
+  STUB_STATUS=$status "$repo/scripts/request_review.sh" 42 > /dev/null || got_exit=$?
+  if [[ $got_exit -ne $want_exit ]] || ! grep -q -- "$want_text" "$STUB_LOG" \
+    || ! grep -q '"pull_request":42,"model":"m1","effort":"high"' "$STUB_LOG" \
+    || ! grep -q 'issues/42/comments' "$STUB_LOG"; then
+    echo "FAIL status=$status exit=$got_exit"; cat "$STUB_LOG"; failures=$((failures + 1))
+  else
+    echo "ok   status=$status exit=$got_exit"
+  fi
+}
+check 200 0 'AI review passed'
+check 422 1 'AI review reported blocking findings'
+check 500 1 'returned HTTP 500'
+check 000 1 'returned HTTP 000'
+exit "$failures"

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+# Fires the cloud review routine for one pull request and posts the result as a comment.
+# Exits 0 when the routine returned a result (passed or blocking findings), 1 when the routine failed.
+pull_request_number=$1
+head_sha=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$pull_request_number" -q .head.sha)
+run_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+
+body=$(jq -cn \
+  --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+  --arg model "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" \
+  --arg effort "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}" \
+  '{pull_request: $pull_request, model: $model, effort: $effort}')
+
+# The routine holds the request open until the review ends, up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" | curl -sS \
+  --max-time 1900 \
+  -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
+  -X POST "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" \
+  -H @- \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  --data "$body") || status=000
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) result="passed"; exit_code=0 ;;
+  422) result="found blocking findings"; exit_code=0 ;;
+  *) result="failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP $status"; exit_code=1 ;;
+esac
+
+gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pull_request_number/comments" \
+  -f body="**ai-review** $result for commit $head_sha. [Workflow run]($run_url)" > /dev/null
+exit "$exit_code"

+#!/bin/bash

+  fi

+  fi

+check 422 0 "**ai-review** found blocking findings for commit abc123"

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+json_escape() {
+  local s=${1//\\/\\\\}
+  printf '%s' "${s//\"/\\\"}"
+}
+payload=$(printf '{"pull_request":%d,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' \
+  "$pull_request_number" "$(json_escape "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}")" "$(json_escape "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}")")
+# The routine holds the request open until the review ends, up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$payload" \
+  "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}") || status=000
+case "$status" in
+  200) result="passed"; exit_code=0 ;;
+  422) result="reported blocking findings"; exit_code=1 ;;
+  *) result="failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP $status"; exit_code=1 ;;
+esac
+run_url="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
+comment=$(printf '{"body":"AI review %s. [Run log](%s)"}' "$result" "$run_url")
+curl -sS --fail-with-body -o /dev/null \
+  -X POST \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$comment" \
+  "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pull_request_number/comments"
+exit "$exit_code"

@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud review routine for one pull request, waits for it, and posts
+# the result as a pull request comment. Exits 0 only when the review passed.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+: "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" "${GH_TOKEN:?}" "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:?}"
+model=${REVIEW_MODEL:?}
+effort=${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}
+[[ $pull_request_number =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "bad pull request number: $pull_request_number" >&2; exit 2; }
+for value in "$model" "$effort"; do
+  [[ $value =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || { echo "unsafe value: $value" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+
+# The routine holds the request open until the review ends (up to 30 minutes).
+status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST "$CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN" \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  -d "{\"pull_request\": $pull_request_number, \"model\": \"$model\", \"effort\": \"$effort\"}") || true
+
+case "$status" in
+  200) result='passed'; code=0 ;;
+  422) result='blocking findings'; code=1 ;;
+  *) result="routine failed (HTTP ${status:-000})"; code=1 ;;
+esac
+echo "ai-review: $result"
+
+body="**ai-review: $result**"
+[ -n "${RUN_URL:-}" ] && body="$body ([run]($RUN_URL))"
+curl -sS --fail -o /dev/null -X POST \
+  "${GITHUB_API_URL:-https://api.github.com}/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pull_request_number/comments" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
+  -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
+  -d "{\"body\": \"$body\"}"
+exit "$code"

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/cloud_review.sh against a local stub that plays both the cloud
+# routine and the GitHub comments API. Checks the exit code and the comment
+# for each routine status.
+set -uo pipefail
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$stub_pid" 2>/dev/null; rm -r "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat >"$work/stub.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, os, sys
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def log_message(self, *a): pass
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        name = "routine" if self.path == "/routine" else "comment"
+        with open(os.path.join(work, name + ".req"), "w") as f:
+            f.write(self.path + "\n" + self.headers.get("Authorization", "") + "\n" + body.decode())
+        code = int(open(os.path.join(work, "status")).read()) if name == "routine" else 201
+        self.send_response(code); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(b"{}")
+s = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+open(os.path.join(work, "port"), "w").write(str(s.server_port))
+s.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 "$work/stub.py" "$work" & stub_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+port=$(cat "$work/port")
+
+fail=0
+check() { # status, expected exit, expected comment text
+  echo "$1" >"$work/status"
+  : >"$work/routine.req"; : >"$work/comment.req"
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/routine" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=tok \
+  REVIEW_MODEL=m1 REVIEW_EFFORT=high GH_TOKEN=ghtok GITHUB_REPOSITORY=o/r \
+  GITHUB_API_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port" RUN_URL=http://run/1 \
+    bash "$root/scripts/cloud_review.sh" 42 >/dev/null 2>&1
+  got=$?
+  if [ "$got" != "$2" ]; then echo "FAIL status $1: exit $got, want $2"; fail=1; fi
+  grep -q '"pull_request": *42' "$work/routine.req" && grep -q 'Bearer tok' "$work/routine.req" \
+    && grep -q '"model": *"m1"' "$work/routine.req" && grep -q '"effort": *"high"' "$work/routine.req" \
+    || { echo "FAIL status $1: bad routine request"; fail=1; }
+  grep -q '^/repos/o/r/issues/42/comments$' "$work/comment.req" && grep -q 'Bearer ghtok' "$work/comment.req" \
+    && grep -q "$3" "$work/comment.req" \
+    || { echo "FAIL status $1: comment missing '$3'"; fail=1; }
+}
+check 200 0 'ai-review: passed'
+check 422 1 'ai-review: blocking findings'
+check 500 1 'ai-review: routine failed (HTTP 500)'
+[ "$fail" = 0 ] && echo PASS
+exit "$fail"

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+head_sha=$(gh pr view "$pull_request_number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid) || head_sha="the current head"
+body=$(jq -n \
+  --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+  --arg model "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" \
+  --arg effort "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}" \
+  '{pull_request: $pull_request, model: $model, effort: $effort}')
+status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$body") || status=000
+case "$status" in
+  200) result="passed"; exit_code=0 ;;
+  422) result="found blocking issues"; exit_code=1 ;;
+  *) result="failed: the cloud routine returned HTTP $status"; exit_code=1 ;;
+esac
+run_url="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
+gh pr comment "$pull_request_number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+  --body "**ai-review ${result}** for ${head_sha}. [Workflow run](${run_url})"
+exit "$exit_code"

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail

+  --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+  --arg model "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" \
+  --arg effort "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}" \

+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+if ! [[ "$pull_request_number" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+  echo "pull request number must be numeric: $pull_request_number" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+for value in "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}"; do
+  if [[ "$value" == *[\"\\]* ]]; then
+    echo "REVIEW_MODEL and REVIEW_EFFORT must not contain quotes or backslashes" >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+done
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%d,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' \
+  "$pull_request_number" "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}")
+# The routine holds the request open until the review ends, up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(curl -sS --max-time 1860 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
+  -X POST "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  --data "$body") || status=000
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "review reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "cloud routine failed (HTTP $status)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac
