+"""Checks the review workflows and the App token check workflow.
+
+Exits with the number of failed checks.
+"""
+import fnmatch
+import os
+import sys
+
+import yaml
+
+failures = 0
+
+
+def check(name, ok):
+    global failures
+    print(("ok   " if ok else "FAIL ") + name)
+    if not ok:
+        failures += 1
+
+
+def load(path):
+    if not os.path.exists(path):
+        return None
+    with open(path) as f:
+        doc = yaml.safe_load(f)
+    # PyYAML reads the bare key `on` as the boolean True.
+    if True in doc:
+        doc["on"] = doc.pop(True)
+    return doc
+
+
+def steps_matching(steps, key, pattern):
+    return [s for s in steps if fnmatch.fnmatch(s.get(key) or "", pattern)]
+
+
+ROUTINE_ENV = {
+    "CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL": "${{ vars.CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL }}",
+    "CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN": "${{ secrets.CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN }}",
+    "REVIEW_MODEL": "${{ vars.REVIEW_MODEL }}",
+    "REVIEW_EFFORT": "${{ vars.REVIEW_EFFORT }}",
+}
+
+for name in ("pr-review", "rerun-review"):
+    path = f".github/workflows/{name}.yml"
+    print(f"-- {path}")
+    job = load(path)["jobs"]["review"]
+    steps = job["steps"]
+    check("runs on [self-hosted, nas]", job.get("runs-on") == ["self-hosted", "nas"])
+    check("job timeout above the 30 minute routine wait", (job.get("timeout-minutes") or 0) > 31)
+    start = steps_matching(steps, "run", "scripts/start_cloud_review.sh *")
+    check("starts the cloud routine", len(start) == 1)
+    check("no longer runs the local reviewer", not steps_matching(steps, "run", "*start_review.sh*"))
+    check("passes the routine URL, token, model and effort",
+          len(start) == 1 and all(start[0].get("env", {}).get(k) == v for k, v in ROUTINE_ENV.items()))
+    check("mints the App token in the job",
+          len(steps_matching(steps, "uses", "actions/create-github-app-token@*")) == 1)
+    complete = [s for s in steps if s.get("name") == "Complete check run"]
+    check("completes the check run on every outcome",
+          len(complete) == 1 and complete[0].get("if") == "always()")
+
+path = ".github/workflows/check-app-token.yml"
+print(f"-- {path}")
+doc = load(path)
+check("file exists", doc is not None)
+if doc is not None:
+    check("triggered by workflow_dispatch", "workflow_dispatch" in (doc.get("on") or {}))
+    jobs = list(doc["jobs"].values())
+    check("one job on [self-hosted, nas]", len(jobs) == 1 and jobs[0].get("runs-on") == ["self-hosted", "nas"])
+    mint = steps_matching(jobs[0]["steps"], "uses", "actions/create-github-app-token@*")
+    check("mints the token with the review App key",
+          len(mint) == 1 and mint[0].get("with") == {
+              "app-id": "${{ vars.REVIEW_APP_ID }}",
+              "private-key": "${{ secrets.REVIEW_APP_KEY }}",
+          })
+
+sys.exit(failures)

+#!/bin/bash
+# Checks the cloud routine port and the App token check workflow.
+# Run from the repository root: tests/test_cloud_review.sh
+set -uo pipefail
+cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
+
+failures=0
+pass() { echo "ok   $1"; }
+fail() { echo "FAIL $1"; failures=$((failures + 1)); }
+check() { if eval "$2"; then pass "$1"; else fail "$1"; fi }
+
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+server_pid=
+cleanup() {
+  [ -n "$server_pid" ] && kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null
+  find "$work" -mindepth 1 -delete
+  rmdir "$work"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+# A local stand-in for the cloud routine. The path picks the status code.
+cat >"$work/server.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+log = sys.argv[2]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        with open(log, "w") as f:
+            json.dump({"auth": self.headers.get("Authorization"),
+                       "type": self.headers.get("Content-Type"),
+                       "body": json.loads(body)}, f)
+        self.send_response(int(self.path.strip("/")))
+        self.end_headers()
+    def log_message(self, *a): pass
+http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), H).serve_forever()
+EOF
+port=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])')
+python3 -I "$work/server.py" "$port" "$work/request.json" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do curl -s -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$port" && break; sleep 0.1; done
+
+run() {
+  CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="$1" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=tok REVIEW_MODEL=m1 REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+    scripts/start_cloud_review.sh "$2" >"$work/out" 2>&1
+}
+
+echo "-- start_cloud_review.sh"
+check "script exists and is executable" '[ -x scripts/start_cloud_review.sh ]'
+run "http://127.0.0.1:$port/200" 42; rc=$?
+check "200 exits 0" '[ $rc -eq 0 ]'
+check "sends bearer token" '[ "$(jq -r .auth "$work/request.json")" = "Bearer tok" ]'
+check "sends JSON content type" '[ "$(jq -r .type "$work/request.json")" = "application/json" ]'
+check "sends pull_request, model, effort" \
+  '[ "$(jq -c .body "$work/request.json")" = "{\"pull_request\":42,\"model\":\"m1\",\"effort\":\"high\"}" ]'
+run "http://127.0.0.1:$port/422" 42; rc=$?
+check "422 exits 1" '[ $rc -eq 1 ]'
+check "422 reports blocking findings" 'grep -q "blocking findings" "$work/out"'
+run "http://127.0.0.1:$port/500" 42; rc=$?
+check "500 exits 1" '[ $rc -eq 1 ]'
+check "500 reports routine failure" 'grep -q "routine failed" "$work/out"'
+closed=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])')
+run "http://127.0.0.1:$closed/200" 42; rc=$?
+check "connection error exits 1" '[ $rc -eq 1 ]'
+check "connection error reports routine failure" 'grep -q "routine failed" "$work/out"'
+run "http://127.0.0.1:$port/200" abc; rc=$?
+check "non-numeric pull request is refused" '[ $rc -ne 0 ]'
+CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/200" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=tok REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+  scripts/start_cloud_review.sh 42 >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?
+check "missing REVIEW_MODEL is refused" '[ $rc -ne 0 ]'
+CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/200" CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=tok REVIEW_MODEL='a"b' REVIEW_EFFORT=high \
+  scripts/start_cloud_review.sh 42 >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?
+check "REVIEW_MODEL with a quote is refused" '[ $rc -eq 2 ]'
+
+python3 -I tests/check_workflows.py || failures=$((failures + $?))
+
+echo
+if [ "$failures" -eq 0 ]; then echo "all checks passed"; else echo "$failures check(s) failed"; exit 1; fi

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud routine (docs/cloud-routine.md) and waits for the review result.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+model=${REVIEW_MODEL:?}
+effort=${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}
+for value in "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort"; do
+  [[ $value =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$ ]] || { echo "unsafe value for JSON body: $value" >&2; exit 2; }
+done
+[[ $pull_request_number =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "pull request number is not a number" >&2; exit 2; }
+body=$(printf '{"pull_request":%s,"model":"%s","effort":"%s"}' "$pull_request_number" "$model" "$effort")
+response=$(mktemp)
+trap 'rm -f "$response"' EXIT
+# The routine holds the POST open for up to 30 minutes.
+status=$(curl -sS -o "$response" -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+  -X POST "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}" \
+  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  --data "$body")
+cat "$response"; echo
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "review passed" ;;
+  422) echo "reviewer reported blocking findings" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "cloud routine failed with HTTP $status" >&2; exit 1 ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+# Fires the cloud routine for one pull request and waits for the review (see docs/cloud-routine.md).
+# Exit 0: review passed (200). Exit 1: blocking findings (422). Exit 2: the routine failed.
+set -euo pipefail
+pull_request_number=$1
+[[ "$pull_request_number" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "pull request number must be numeric" >&2; exit 2; }
+headers=$(mktemp)
+trap 'unlink "$headers"' EXIT
+# Keep the token off the command line.
+printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN:?}" > "$headers"
+body=$(
+  jq -nc \
+    --argjson pull_request "$pull_request_number" \
+    --arg model "${REVIEW_MODEL:?}" \
+    --arg effort "${REVIEW_EFFORT:?}" \
+    '{pull_request: $pull_request, model: $model, effort: $effort}'
+)
+status=$(
+  printf '%s' "$body" |
+  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1860 \
+    -X POST -H @"$headers" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+    --data-binary @- "${CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL:?}"
+) || true
+case "$status" in
+  200) echo "Review passed." ;;
+  422) echo "::error::The reviewer reported blocking findings."; exit 1 ;;
+  *) echo "::error::Cloud routine failed with HTTP status ${status:-none}."; exit 2 ;;
+esac

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Checks that the review workflows run on the NAS runner through the cloud routine."""
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import yaml
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+WORKFLOWS = ROOT / ".github" / "workflows"
+failures = []
+
+
+def check(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        failures.append(message)
+
+
+def load(name):
+    path = WORKFLOWS / name
+    if not path.exists():
+        failures.append(f"{name}: missing")
+        return None
+    doc = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
+    # PyYAML reads the bare key `on` as True.
+    doc["on"] = doc.pop(True, doc.get("on"))
+    return doc
+
+
+for name in ("pr-review.yml", "rerun-review.yml"):
+    doc = load(name)
+    if doc is None:
+        continue
+    job = doc["jobs"]["review"]
+    runs = [s.get("run", "") for s in job["steps"]]
+    check(job["runs-on"] == ["self-hosted", "nas"], f"{name}: runs-on is {job['runs-on']}")
+    check(not any("start_review.sh" in r for r in runs), f"{name}: still starts the reviewer on the runner")
+    check(any("cloud_review.sh" in r for r in runs), f"{name}: does not call the cloud routine")
+    check(any("check_run.sh open" in r for r in runs), f"{name}: does not open the check run")
+    complete = [s for s in job["steps"] if "check_run.sh complete" in s.get("run", "")]
+    check(complete and complete[0].get("if") == "always()", f"{name}: check run is not always completed")
+    check(complete and "${{ job.status }}" in complete[0]["run"], f"{name}: check run conclusion does not come from job.status")
+    check(job.get("timeout-minutes", 0) > 30, f"{name}: timeout-minutes must exceed the routine's 30 minutes")
+
+doc = load("check-app-token.yml")
+if doc is not None:
+    check("workflow_dispatch" in doc["on"], "check-app-token.yml: not a workflow_dispatch workflow")
+    jobs = list(doc["jobs"].values())
+    check(any(j["runs-on"] == ["self-hosted", "nas"] for j in jobs), "check-app-token.yml: no job on the NAS runner")
+    uses = [s.get("uses", "") for j in jobs for s in j["steps"]]
+    check(any(u.startswith("actions/create-github-app-token@") for u in uses), "check-app-token.yml: does not mint a token")
+
+for failure in failures:
+    print("FAIL", failure)
+print("PASS" if not failures else f"{len(failures)} failure(s)")
+sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/cloud_review.sh against a stub curl and checks the exit code for each HTTP status.
+set -uo pipefail
+root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+stub=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'find "$stub" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$stub"' EXIT
+cat > "$stub/curl" <<'EOF'
+#!/bin/bash
+printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_DIR/args"
+cat > "$STUB_DIR/body"
+printf '%s' "$STUB_STATUS"
+EOF
+chmod +x "$stub/curl"
+
+export STUB_DIR=$stub CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL=https://routine.example/fire CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=secret-token
+export REVIEW_MODEL='model"x\\y' REVIEW_EFFORT=high
+fail=0
+for case in "200 0" "422 1" "500 2" "000 2"; do
+  set -- $case
+  STUB_STATUS=$1 PATH="$stub:$PATH" "$root/scripts/cloud_review.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+  got=$?
+  if [ "$got" != "$2" ]; then echo "FAIL status $1: exit $got, want $2"; fail=1; fi
+done
+if ! grep -qxF '{"pull_request":42,"model":"model\"x\\\\y","effort":"high"}' "$stub/body" 2>/dev/null; then
+  echo "FAIL body: $(cat "$stub/body" 2>/dev/null)"; fail=1
+fi
+# The routine can wait 30 minutes, so curl must wait longer.
+if ! grep -A1 -x -- --max-time "$stub/args" 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 | awk '{exit !($1 > 1800)}'; then
+  echo "FAIL curl --max-time must exceed 1800 seconds"; fail=1
+fi
+: > "$stub/body"
+STUB_STATUS=200 REVIEW_MODEL= PATH="$stub:$PATH" "$root/scripts/cloud_review.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1
+if [ $? = 0 ] || [ -s "$stub/body" ]; then echo "FAIL routine called with REVIEW_MODEL unset"; fail=1; fi
+if grep -q secret-token "$stub/args" 2>/dev/null; then
+  echo "FAIL token passed on the curl command line"; fail=1
+fi
+[ $fail = 0 ] && echo PASS
+exit $fail

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs scripts/start_review.sh against a local mock of the cloud routine.
+set -euo pipefail
+repo=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/mock.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        with open(f"{work}/request.json", "w") as f:
+            json.dump({"auth": self.headers.get("Authorization"),
+                       "type": self.headers.get("Content-Type"),
+                       "body": json.loads(body)}, f)
+        status = int(open(f"{work}/status").read())
+        self.send_response(status)
+        self.end_headers()
+        self.wfile.write(b'{"detail":"mock"}')
+    def log_message(self, *a): pass
+s = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+print(s.server_port, flush=True)
+s.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 -I "$work/mock.py" "$work" > "$work/port" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$(cat "$work/port")/fire"
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=test-token REVIEW_MODEL=test-model REVIEW_EFFORT=high
+failures=0
+expect() {
+  local status=$1 want_exit=$2 got_exit=0
+  echo "$status" > "$work/status"
+  "$repo/scripts/start_review.sh" 42 > /dev/null 2>&1 || got_exit=$?
+  if [ "$got_exit" -ne "$want_exit" ]; then
+    echo "FAIL: status $status gave exit $got_exit, want $want_exit"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if ! jq -e '.auth == "Bearer test-token" and .type == "application/json"
+      and .body == {"pull_request": 42, "model": "test-model", "effort": "high"}' "$work/request.json" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "FAIL: status $status: wrong request: $(cat "$work/request.json" 2>/dev/null || echo none)"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  echo "ok: status $status gives exit $got_exit"
+}
+expect 200 0
+expect 422 1
+expect 500 1
+[ "$failures" -eq 0 ]

+#!/bin/bash
+# Runs start_review.sh against a local fake cloud routine and checks each status mapping.
+set -euo pipefail
+here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
+work=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$work/server.py" <<'EOF'
+import http.server, json, sys
+work = sys.argv[1]
+class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    def do_POST(self):
+        body = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"]))
+        with open(work + "/request.json", "w") as f:
+            json.dump({"auth": self.headers.get("Authorization"), "body": json.loads(body)}, f)
+        status = int(open(work + "/status").read())
+        self.send_response(status)
+        self.end_headers()
+        self.wfile.write(b"routine says hi")
+    def log_message(self, *a):
+        pass
+s = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+open(work + "/port", "w").write(str(s.server_port))
+s.serve_forever()
+EOF
+python3 "$work/server.py" "$work" &
+server_pid=$!
+for _ in $(seq 50); do [ -s "$work/port" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
+
+port=$(cat "$work/port")
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$port/fire"
+export CLOUD_ROUTINE_TOKEN=test-token REVIEW_MODEL=test-model REVIEW_EFFORT=high
+failures=0
+
+expect() {
+  local status=$1 want_exit=$2
+  echo "$status" > "$work/status"
+  rm -f "$work/request.json"
+  local got_exit=0
+  bash "$here/start_review.sh" 42 > "$work/out" 2>&1 || got_exit=$?
+  if [ "$got_exit" != "$want_exit" ]; then
+    echo "FAIL: routine status $status gave exit $got_exit, want $want_exit"; cat "$work/out"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  if [ "$(jq -c . "$work/request.json")" != '{"auth":"Bearer test-token","body":{"pull_request":42,"model":"test-model","effort":"high"}}' ]; then
+    echo "FAIL: routine status $status: unexpected request"; cat "$work/request.json"; failures=$((failures + 1)); return
+  fi
+  echo "ok: routine status $status gives exit $want_exit"
+}
+
+expect 200 0
+expect 422 1
+expect 500 1
+expect 401 1
+
+got_exit=0
+bash "$here/start_review.sh" not-a-number > "$work/out" 2>&1 || got_exit=$?
+if [ "$got_exit" = 0 ]; then echo "FAIL: non-numeric pull request accepted"; failures=$((failures + 1)); else echo "ok: non-numeric pull request rejected"; fi
+
+if [ "$failures" != 0 ]; then echo "$failures failed"; exit 1; fi
+echo "all passed"
